items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: because everybody had (Congolene) on their hair

ctx.x: I mean, this was something new. They hadn't had a black show.

It was something new and it was something like that occasion in Copenhagen that happened. Some of them were waiting to see gorillas and baboons and everything. They didn't know what they were going to see. Well, when these guys come at that time, because they didn't -- they didn't see no bad looking guys, because everybody had (Congolene) on their hair and everybody -- and they couldn't believe that we were Africans. See, some of them said, 'Well they must be from Brazil or some other place. They can't be…
